findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_notes, get_note · Private data: get_vertical · Public sink: search_data_buyers · Destructive: get_market_sector, get_public_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_notes, get_note · Private data: get_vertical · Public sink: search_data_buyers · Destructive: get_market_sector, get_public_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
